notes: The FY2025 20-F lists Ryanair's 93 operating bases (as of May 16, 2025) by airport name only, with no country or per-base aircraft, passenger or staff counts. Counting bases per country would mean mapping airports to countries ourselves, so no country rows were made. No passengers-by-country, employees-by-country or taxes-by-country disclosure was found in the 20-F (it reports 25,952 staff at March 31, 2025 by category, and revenue by country only where above 10%, which is already in the records). Sites are 12 of the 'principal facilities owned or leased by the Ryanair Group' table (site area and floor space in square meters, not recorded as values); the same table also lists East Midlands (simulator training), Travel Labs offices in Madrid and Wroclaw, and administrative offices in Warsaw, Pieta (Malta) and Vienna.
